category_title: Students who communicate knowledge through visual and performing arts to overcome vocabulary limitations
scenario_title: Frustration with media limitations during creative project
minimal_context: The student is using watercolors in art class to create a personal landscape representing the weather.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start using the watercolors to create your personal landscape to represent the weather.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Paints on the paper) I am trying to express the weather, but the watercolor is not giving me the detail I want.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I messed up the details. Every time I mess up something, I try again.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and try again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Paints over the same spot repeatedly) When I get it wrong, I try again and again. So, I never give up. But the watercolor still won't give me the detail I want for my landscape!
